            pos_logits, neg_logits = model(seq_t, pos_t, neg_t)
            indices = pos_t.ne(0)
            if not indices.any():
                raise ValueError("Training batch contains no valid targets")
            positive = pos_logits[indices]
            negative = neg_logits[indices]
            pair_loss = nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(
                positive, torch.ones_like(positive), reduction="none"
            ) + nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(
                negative, torch.zeros_like(negative), reduction="none"
            )
            if VARIANT == "later-target":
                positions = torch.arange(pos_t.shape[1], device=device)
                last = positions.expand_as(pos_t).masked_fill(~indices, -1).amax(1)
                distances = last[:, None] - positions[None, :]
                weights = torch.exp(-TARGET_DECAY * distances[indices].float())
            else:
                weights = torch.ones_like(pair_loss)
            # With weights=1 this is mean(positive BCE)+mean(negative BCE),
            # exactly the starting objective's scaling, rather than half of it.
            loss = (weights * pair_loss).sum() / weights.sum()
